title: Single Crochet
description: Learn the most useful beginner stitch for compact, sturdy fabric.

content.summary: Insert the hook, pull up a loop, and complete a simple stitch with two loops on the hook.
content.whyItMatters: Single crochet is a core stitch used in coasters, amigurumi, dishcloths, and borders.
steps: Insert the hook into the next stitch.
Yarn over and pull up a loop.
Yarn over again and pull through both loops.
content.practice: Work 3 rows of 10 single crochet stitches.
commonMistakes: Accidentally skipping the last stitch in the row.
Adding extra stitches at the edges without noticing.
